t: The Brenner Washroom Surface Cleaner 1Ltr is a ready-to-use liquid designed to maintain hygienic conditions across diverse sanitary facilities. Perfect for commercial cleaning contractors and maintenance teams working in high-traffic commercial toilets, offices and public changing rooms, this high-performance formula quickly cuts through grime. The efficient bathroom cleaning spray removes stubborn water marks and prevents limescale build-up when applied regularly, leaving hard surfaces looking spotless.
